how_to_use: NTS conformance kit (P7-01). Each entry is one file with an expected verdict. A conforming consumer accepts the files with expect = accept and rejects the others. A producer-side validator (nts-conform check) reports no failed check for verdict accept, only the listed warning checks for accept-with-warnings, and at least the listed failing checks for reject. 'rules' are the NTS 1.0 RC4 rule ids that the file exercises (spec Appendix C).
